scan_gate.policy: trained sensing policy, deterministic (argmax), LSTM reset per episode
scan_gate.gate: real-robot gate + set_target_fps (AdaptiveSensing/evaluation/scan_gate.py), decision at each control instant gates that instant's native scan (temporal_sensing.py)
scan_gate.note: lidar.npz and steps.csv scan_fresh hold the ACCEPTED scans (NAV05's observation)

robot.action: a in [-1, 1]^2 -> command (a0 * v_max, a1 * w_max)

actuator.model: calibrated command model (delay, first-order lag, gains, wheel saturation)

lidar.rotation_convention: REP-103: R = Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll) (sensor -> base_link); pitch > 0 tilts the sensor's forward axis down

noise.model: additive Gaussian N(0, sigma^2) on rays with a return, clamped to [0, range_max]; no-return rays unchanged
noise.seeding: per episode, acquisition physics tick and ray (see random_seeds)

lidar.geometry_note: azimuth_deg / elevation_deg / ray_dirs_s in the sensor frame (x forward, y left, z up), ray_dirs_b in base_link (mount rotation applied); see lidar_scans_note

sensing.timing: control-quantized: a scan is acquired at the first control instant at or after each due time (due times every period_s); all rays of a scan acquired simultaneously
sensing.note: lidar.npz per-scan layout: fresh[k] = a scan was acquired at step k

terminations.clearance: footprint clearance = distance to the nearest wall / active obstacle - footprint radius

random_seeds.note: counter-based (st_nav/crng.py): episode_seed = key(env seed, env index, episode number); obstacle draws = uniform(obstacle_seed, stream, obstacle, counter); LiDAR noise of beam b acquired at physics tick t = uniform(lidar_noise_seed, t, b)

timebase: t_sim = simulated seconds since reset; trajectory / lidar / obstacles row k = after step k (row 0 = reset); steps row k = step k
lidar_scans_note: per-scan layout: ranges / ranges_clean (S, R) = acquired scans (observed with noise / noise-free), scan_step / scan_t_sim = control-step row and time of acquisition, origin_xyz / base_quat_wxyz = sensor origin (env-local) and base orientation at acquisition; row_scan_index[k] = scan in the observation after step k (terminal row: the last acquired scan, not observed); ray r points along R(base_quat_wxyz) @ ray_dirs_b[r] from origin_xyz; range image cell (grid_row[r], grid_col[r])
lidar_rows_note: ranges = the observation the policy received after step k (row 0: reset observation; last row NaN: the terminal state is not observed); ranges_clean = noise-free ranges at the end of step k for every row; origin_* = sensor pose when `ranges` was acquired (terminal row: the pose of ranges_clean)

files.metadata.json: episode, outcome, seeds, robot, actuator, LiDAR, sensing, moving obstacles, DR flags
files.world_geometry.json: all walls of this episode (cx, cy, length, thickness, yaw) and moving-obstacle paths
files.trajectory.csv: row k = robot state after step k (row 0 = reset): pose, base_link velocity, goal distance, clearance
files.steps.csv: row k = step k: policy action in [-1, 1], command (m/s, rad/s), actuator output, reward terms, sensing, done
files.lidar.npz: 2D: row k = scan of the observation after step k: ranges (observed, noisy; NaN where not observed), ranges_clean, per-beam acquisition time/flag, sensor origin pose at acquisition. 3D (layout per_scan): acquired scans only + row_scan_index (see lidar_scans_note)
files.obstacles.npz: moving obstacles: ids, radius, active, x/y per row (row k = after step k)
